description: DistrictLab-H provides computer-aided engineering for district thermal networks, combining production, distribution and consumption in a thermal-hydraulic calculation tool. The provider describes GIS-based model construction and static or dynamic sizing studies. The provider is DistrictLab. Coverage: The software supports several network architectures and meshed or tree layouts. Geographic coverage and analysis periods are defined by the user. Access: The provider publishes a product description and contact route. No demonstration or installer was requested. Licence and cost: The product page does not state a price or full licence conditions. Access requires confirmation from the provider. Limitations: Speed, accuracy and energy-loss claims are vendor statements and were not independently tested. This draft describes the tool, not its testimonial cases. For simulation it supports design comparisons, operating-control studies and analysis of heat distribution losses. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
